title: Evidence map: is MHC diversity linked to H5N1 resistance in wild birds?
caption: Direct evidence exists only in domestic chicken lab lines (Mx(A)/BF2(B21) resistant vs Mx(G)/BF2(B13) susceptible, KEGG GSEA of tracheal RNA-seq), plus MHC characterisation in unrelated taxa. The wild-bird column — the actual question — is empty.
